intro: KB Skincare’s Botox Cream is a rejuvenating face cream formulated to make your skin look healthy, youthful, and radiant. Enriched with the powerful benefits of Collagen, Peptides, and Vitamin-C, this cream helps improve skin elasticity, enhance firmness, and brighten dull skin.
Collagen – Supports skin structure and reduces the appearance of fine lines.
Peptides – Boost natural skin repair and improve smoothness.
Vitamin-C – Brightens the complexion and protects against free-radical damage.
The lightweight formula absorbs quickly, making it suitable for all skin types. With regular use, your skin feels softer, firmer, and visibly refreshed.
